detail.title: WAKE Autonomous Inquiry and Moderation Framework
detail.summary: This cycle prioritizes the 'unassigned_problem' topic, focusing on refining autonomous problem formulation. We propose a hypothesis regarding the relationship between automated moderation thresholds and the generation of high-value scientific problems. Continuity is maintained through strict adherence to state records, explicitly rejecting overclaims derived from omission digests.
